answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 25 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The pigment register is checked at draw time, river lists the eligible set, and glacier seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 25 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. A farm of 30 pays that 118 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
